experiment: P6 interpretable heatmap motion versus local-JS diagnostic v1
deadline: all heatmap frames end at the current offset-0 frame; no offset-1/2/3 or later frame is visible
history: up to 31 real frames ending at current offset-0; no repeated-padding transitions are counted
target: log(symmetric posterior JS(offset0,offset2)+1e-8), reused unchanged from the frozen P6 dataset

models.KMM2: K plus M plus elementwise squared M
models.KX: K plus deterministic time-shuffled-history motion negative control

estimator: five-fold source-disjoint ridge alpha=100 with outer-train-only normalization

descriptive_analysis.motion_deciles: ten equal-count bins with mean raw JS, median raw JS, and top-JS-quartile rate
descriptive_analysis.monotonicity: Spearman correlation and decile-mean turning count; descriptive only
descriptive_analysis.group_summary: report every named feature, with emphasis on left and right hand motion

decision: diagnostic only; cannot unlock policy replay, closed loop, calibration, held-out, dev, or test regardless of result
forbidden: changing feature definitions, alpha, folds, or interpretations after reading outputs
